svg.text: Capacity/work coordinate variants remove direct traction pressure and keep blood volume owned by venous and valve flows.
best phase-oriented force-balance: force-balance-cap28-drive4-hyd002-stiff1-damp04-fast, source 2/7, topology 5/7, source+topology 2/7, MVF 3/7
PV markers: filled circle = MV opening, hollow circle = MV closure, dashed line = reservoir closure-to-opening chord; post-opening conduit should descend below that chord.
